pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2.pali: Tattha jātakaṁ uppalaṁ vā padumaṁ vā puṇḍarīkaṁ vā bhisaṁ vā macchaṁ vā kacchapaṁ vā pañcamāsakaṁ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṁ vā agghanakaṁ theyyacitto āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

translations.tv_bu-vb-pj2_translation-en-brahmali: If, intending to steal, he touches either a red or white lotus or a blue water lily growing there, or a lotus root, or a fish, or a turtle having a value of five māsaka coins or more, he commits an offense of wrong conduct.

sn35.240.pali: Siṅgālopi kho, bhikkhave, addasa kummaṁ kacchapaṁ dūratova gocarapasutaṁ.

translations.de_sabbamitta: Aber auch der Schakal sah die Schildkröte von Weitem grasen.
translations.en_sujato: But the jackal also saw the tortoise off in the distance grazing.
translations.lt_piyadassi: Šakalas taip pat pamatė tolumoje maisto ieškantį vėžlį.
translations.ru_o: И шакал тоже, монахи, увидел черепаху издали, пищу-ищущую,

sn35.240.pali: Disvāna yena kummo kacchapo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā kummaṁ kacchapaṁ paccupaṭṭhito ahosi:

translations.de_sabbamitta: Da ging er zu ihr hin und wartete in der Nähe; er dachte:
translations.en_sujato: So it went up to the tortoise and waited nearby, thinking,
translations.lt_piyadassi: Pamatęs, nuėjo prie jo laukti šalia, galvodamas:
translations.ru_o: Увидев, где черепаха подошёл; подойдя черепахи напротив встал (напротив-стоящим стал):

translations.de_sabbamitta: Denk an die einäugige Schildkröte und das Joch mit einer Öffnung,
translations.en_soma: Bear in mind the one-eyed turtle in the eastern sea,
translations.en_sujato: Remember the one-eyed turtle <j>and the yoke with a hole
